title: Sermones / «Проповеди» Кесария (Цезария) Арелатского
author: Caesarius of Arles
edition: Morin (1937–42) = CCSL 103–104 (1953); many sermons are in public-domain PL 39 (Pseudo-Augustinian appendix)
ru_evidence: azbyka.ru lists only 'Избранные слова (12, 39, 40)' + one Nativity sermon; ru.wikipedia says only the Vita Caesarii was translated into Russian (2014/2016)
en_evidence: M. M. Mueller, Sermons I–III (FOTC 31, 47, 66; CUA Press), cited in ru.wikipedia
other_translations: French, Italian, German and Polish translations of the sermons (per ru.wikipedia)
value: Preaching to the peasants of 6th-century Gaul: Kalends festivals, augury, amulets, healing cults, drinking, rural life. The principal source for late Roman popular religion and 'pagan survivals' in the post-Roman West.
pilot_unit: c. 12 sermons on pagan practices (e.g. 13, 33, 50–54, 192–193); est. 15k words
